scripts.example:simple:inox: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && pnpm run boringssl:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/simple -B dist/examples/simple/build-inox-libuv-boringssl -DINOX_COMPILER_MODE=native -DINOX_LOOP_BACKEND=libuv -DINOX_TLS_BACKEND=boringssl && cmake --build dist/examples/simple/build-inox-libuv-boringssl && ./dist/examples/simple/build-inox-libuv-boringssl/inox_cmake_example
scripts.example:simple:libuv: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/simple -B dist/examples/simple/build-libuv -DINOX_COMPILER_MODE=node -DINOX_LOOP_BACKEND=libuv && cmake --build dist/examples/simple/build-libuv && ./dist/examples/simple/build-libuv/inox_cmake_example
scripts.example:simple:libuv-boringssl: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && pnpm run boringssl:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/simple -B dist/examples/simple/build-libuv-boringssl -DINOX_COMPILER_MODE=node -DINOX_LOOP_BACKEND=libuv -DINOX_TLS_BACKEND=boringssl && cmake --build dist/examples/simple/build-libuv-boringssl && ./dist/examples/simple/build-libuv-boringssl/inox_cmake_example
scripts.example:http-server: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/http-server -B dist/http-server/build -DINOX_COMPILER_MODE=node && cmake --build dist/http-server/build && ./dist/http-server/out/node/http-server
scripts.example:http-server:inox: pnpm run libuv:bootstrap && cmake -S examples/http-server -B dist/http-server/build-inox -DINOX_COMPILER_MODE=native && cmake --build dist/http-server/build-inox && ./dist/http-server/out/native/http-server
scripts.test:inox: node scripts/test-log.ts dist/test-inox.log -- node tests/all.test.ts --compiler dist/inox
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/test-log.ts dist/test.log -- node tests/all.test.ts tests/smoke
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run test:features
